type MachinePreparation struct
  Request MachineScopeKind
  Offer MachineScopeKind
  OfferHost string
  NormalServiceAddress string
  BindingName string
type MachineRequestIdentity struct
  Epoch string
  ExpiresMs int64
  Nonce string
type MachineDirection struct
  Kind MachineScopeKind
  Host string
  ServiceAddress string
type MachineAgreement struct
  PeerKey string
  Check string
  Transcript string
  Semantics string
  Given MachineDirection
  Received MachineDirection
type MachineOperation struct
  ID string
  Phase MachinePhase
  ExpiresMs int64
  Reason string
  Agreement *MachineAgreement
  QuestionID string
  Revision string
type MachineStart struct
  Outcome MachineStartOutcome
  Operation *MachineOperation
  Code string
type MachineObservation struct
  Outcome MachineObserveOutcome
  Cursor string
  Operation *MachineOperation
type MachineCancellation struct
  Outcome MachineCancelOutcome
  Operation *MachineOperation
type MachineRecord struct
  PeerKey string
  State string
  ServiceAddress string
  LastCallUnixMs int64
  BindingName string
type MachinePage struct
  Outcome MachineListOutcome
  Epoch string
  RequestExpiresMs int64
  Revision string
  NextCursor string
  Machines []MachineRecord
  LocalServiceAddress string
type MachineRemoval struct
  Outcome MachineRemoveOutcome
  Revision string
type EndpointRefusalDetail struct
  Source EndpointRefusalSource
  Decision EndpointRefusalDecision
  Ask EndpointRefusalAsk
  Action string
  Question string
  Credential string
  RetryAfterMs int64
type EndpointProducerCheck struct
  Kind string
  Copy string
  State EndpointProducerCheckState
  Reason string
  Checked string
type EndpointServiceState struct
  Service string
  Readiness EndpointServiceReadiness
  Reason string
  Guarantees []string
  Capabilities map[string]string
  DefinitionHash string
type EndpointDescription struct
  Outcome EndpointDescriptionOutcome
  Program string
  Version string
  Services []EndpointServiceState
  Refusal *EndpointRefusalDetail
  Reason string
  Checks []EndpointProducerCheck
type EndpointDescriptionResult struct
  Value EndpointDescription
func Encode(v *MachineStart) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
const TimestampLayout
func FormatTimestamp(at time.Time) string
func Decode(in []byte) (*MachineStart, error)
func ToJSON(v any) (out []byte, err error)
func FromJSON(data []byte, v any) error
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
const EndpointV2Contract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
func DescribeEndpointWithChecks(frame []byte, program, version string, checks []EndpointProducerCheck, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
func ServeEndpointWithChecks(frame []byte, program, version string, checks []EndpointProducerCheck, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
func ServeEndpointRemote(frame []byte, program, version string, admit func(contract, method, profile string) error, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
func RemoteMethodProfile(service interface{}, contract, method string) string
type MachineControl interface
  StartOffer(request MachineRequestIdentity, invitationAddress string, preparation MachinePreparation) (MachineStart, error)
  Enter(request MachineRequestIdentity, code string, preparation MachinePreparation) (MachineStart, error)
  Observe(operationID, after string, waitMs int64) (MachineObservation, error)
  Cancel(operationID string) (MachineCancellation, error)
  List(cursor string, limit int64) (MachinePage, error)
  Remove(expectedRevision, peerKey string) (MachineRemoval, error)
type MachineControlTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type MachineControlClient struct
func NewMachineControlClient(t MachineControlTransport) *MachineControlClient
type MachineControlDispatcher struct
  Handler MachineControl
func (MachineControlDispatcher) RemoteMethodProfile(contract, method string) (string, bool)
func (MachineControlClient) StartOffer(request MachineRequestIdentity, invitationAddress string, preparation MachinePreparation) (result MachineStart, err error)
func (MachineControlClient) Enter(request MachineRequestIdentity, code string, preparation MachinePreparation) (result MachineStart, err error)
func (MachineControlClient) Observe(operationID, after string, waitMs int64) (result MachineObservation, err error)
func (MachineControlClient) Cancel(operationID string) (result MachineCancellation, err error)
func (MachineControlClient) List(cursor string, limit int64) (result MachinePage, err error)
func (MachineControlClient) Remove(expectedRevision, peerKey string) (result MachineRemoval, err error)
func (MachineControlDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (MachineControlDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (MachineControlDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (MachineControlDispatcher) DescribeServiceDefinitionHash() string
func (MachineControlDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (MachineControlDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
